intro.text: Constable-general of Elendel's Sixth Octant in 342.

items.text: Drapen was a guest at Wax and Steris's first try at a public wedding and was soaked when Wayne's sabotage sent water pouring through the ceiling. While Wax helped him to his carriage, he grumbled that the water had ruined his pistol, which would now need cleaning and oiling.
